summary: Iter15 — Phase 6B.4.5b/c (Join Us foundation roles + sample partners). NEW test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_foundation_roles.py (21 tests, all PASS). Backend: all 3 seeded roles returned by /api/foundation-roles with full required fields, seeded_member_id linked to existing governing_members; /foundation-role-applications submits correctly (rejects unknown slug 404, short why_drawn 422); admin CRUD on /admin/foundation-roles works (create/duplicate-400/update/delete); /admin/foundation-role-applications protected by auth, supports status filter, decision endpoint moves status + rejects invalid status; /api/partners default excludes 8 sample profiles; /api/partners?samples=1 returns exactly 8 sample profiles; partner_type filter works; individual sample slug fetch works. Frontend: /join-us lists 3 open roles with Apply CTAs; /join-us/board-chair-cofounder shows the apply form (data-testids present: apply-name, apply-email, apply-current-role, apply-why-drawn, apply-resume, apply-linkedin, apply-phone); submitting a valid form shows 'Thank you' screen + green toast; new application visible in /admin/foundation-applications; /governance shows SAMPLE ribbons on Aurelia/Tomas/Hannah cards, James Reagan unmarked (correct), '3 open seats' banner + 3 'Apply for this role' links to /join-us/<slug>; /partners?samples=1 shows the SAMPLE PROFILES banner + all 8 sample cards with gold SAMPLE ribbons; /partners default hides them; /partners/sample-maya-chen detail page shows the sample banner; /admin/foundation-roles lists all 3 with Edit/Delete + 'New role'; /admin/foundation-applications shows 6 status tabs.
critical_code_review_comments: foundation_roles.py admin_decide takes `status` as a query param while POSTing a JSON body for admin_note — slightly unusual REST shape but matches the route as documented in the request; works correctly and matches both the admin UI client and the test harness.

list_public_partners samples query is implemented correctly with mutually exclusive branches: samples=1 -> {is_sample:true}; default -> {$or:[{is_sample:{$ne:true}},{is_sample:{$exists:false}}]}. The $or merge logic when both samples+search text are combined uses an $and wrapper — confirmed working but a touch noisy. Not a bug.

ensure_sample_partners_seeded and ensure_foundation_roles_seeded are both idempotent by slug — safe to call on every boot. Sample partner_profiles use user_id=None which is correctly handled by the public list/detail paths (no user joins required).
Both new POST submit endpoints (foundation-role-applications and the admin decision endpoint) properly strip _id before returning. No ObjectId leakage observed in any of the 21 test responses.
Models for FoundationRoleCreate enforce min_length on headline/who_you_are/what_youll_do/what_you_bring — caught by tests (initial test payload was too short). Good defensive validation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all critical flows verified (list, detail, apply submission, governance ribbons + open-seats banner, partners samples toggle, sample detail banner, admin roles CRUD UI, admin apps queue with submitted test app visible)

seed_data_creation: Submitted 2 TEST_ foundation role applications (test_iter15@example.com, test_frontend_iter15@example.com) via the public endpoint and via the /join-us UI respectively. test_iter15@example.com was moved to 'reviewing' status during the admin decision test. Both rows remain in foundation_role_applications collection — they're prefixed with 'TEST' in name/email for easy identification. No partner_profiles or foundation_roles were mutated; the test-iter15-temp-role row was created and deleted within the CRUD test class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter15 is fully green. The 21-test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_foundation_roles.py is safe to rerun (idempotent: TEST_ applications accumulate harmlessly; the temp role is created+deleted within the same class). The 2 TEST_ foundation_role_applications in the DB can be cleaned via direct Mongo if desired. Frontend admin UI requires logging in as admin@birthright.org first; the Join Us application form is fully public (no auth).
rca of the issue: No bug found. 5 initial test failures were all test-payload issues (input strings shorter than the Pydantic min_length constraints on FoundationRoleCreate, and a missing name on the unknown-role submission test). Fixed the test payloads to satisfy the model validators; all 21 tests then passed. The 401 errors visible in the browser console on /join-us are unrelated background calls to /api/auth/me (the layout tries to load the current user; correctly returns 401 for anonymous visitors and the page degrades cleanly to the public 'Sign in / Join' header).
